name: OpenContracts
description: Document intelligence platform for annotating and analysing document collections, with agents that answer questions over a corpus.
whatItDoes: Lets legal and knowledge teams upload documents, annotate them, extract structured data and chat with agents about a single document or a whole corpus. Answers link back to source passages.
howItWorks: A Django backend with a React front end stores documents, annotations and embeddings, and runs corpus and document agents with tool access. It ships a built-in MCP server and is deployed with Docker Compose from sample env files.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Needed for agent and extraction features
